findings.evidence: The lift proof at `Lift.lean:315-320` must split on `j < e.totient` solely to satisfy this stronger extensionality signature, while all coordinate vectors in the PR use `Fin e.totient`.
findings.fix: State the hypothesis as `∀ j : Fin e.totient, x.coeff j = y.coeff j`; out-of-range coefficients are already zero by `coeff_eq_zero_of_totient_le`.
findings.issue: `Cyclotomic.ext` requires equality at every natural index, although only the `Fin e.totient` basis coordinates determine an element.

findings.evidence: `Prime.lean:173-175` already states the neighboring integer-lift result at the weaker `IsGoodDixonPrime G p` level using exactly the same bound.
findings.fix: Put the lemma in `IsGoodDixonPrime` with signature `(hp : IsGoodDixonPrime G p) ...`, or inline the one-line arithmetic argument in the three Dixon lift theorems.
findings.issue: `two_mul_natAbs_lt_of_natAbs_le_sqrt` is unnecessarily attached to `DixonPrimeData`; its chosen primitive root is irrelevant, and the proof uses only `d.isGoodDixonPrime.two_mul_sqrt_lt`.

summary: Two public declarations impose stronger inputs than their mathematical content requires.
